description: Pistol expansion: two shared three-way specialization groups plus one standalone base-family signature. Unique variants reuse the BPRUE modules of their base family and can receive an additional unique signature module separately.

quick_response.name: Quick-Response Package
quick_response.concept: PTM emergency-sidearm package: faster aiming, reload and lower weight in exchange for recoil and wear.

match_barrel.name: Match Barrel Assembly
match_barrel.concept: UDP precision package: tighter dispersion, longer effective falloff and higher projectile speed in exchange for slower handling.

automatic_sear.name: Automatic Sear
automatic_sear.concept: APB/APSB fire-control conversion: retains its native three-round burst and adds automatic fire via ChangeFireTypeEffectBurstAuto.

hunting_cylinder.name: Hunting Cylinder
hunting_cylinder.concept: Rhino heavy-hunter package: improved armor penetration and projectile velocity in exchange for a slower firing cycle.

selectable_fire_control.name: Selectable Fire Control
selectable_fire_control.concept: M10 fire-control package: retains native automatic fire and adds semi-automatic fire via ChangeFireTypeEffectSemiAuto.

heavy_slide.name: Heavy Slide Assembly
heavy_slide.concept: Kora heavy-slide package: improved recoil control, recovery and durability in exchange for slower aiming.
